verdict.rationale: Supermemory offers a self-hosting option where 'Supermemory runs on your own hardware... data never leaves the building,' which lets a user fully control where data is stored, but there is no documented region/residency selection (e.g., EU vs US data center choice) within the hosted SaaS platform itself. missing for 10: hosted-platform region/residency picker, data-center location guarantees, compliance certifications (SOC2/GDPR data locality) for the managed service.
